create_coco_subset_with_n_images: create a COCOSubsetWithNImages to sample a fixed number of images from a COCO dataset using frontmost or random sampling
create_coco_subset_with_given_images: create a COCOSubsetWithGivenImages to filter a COCO dataset down to a specific list of image file names
create_coco_with_classes_to_use: create a COCOWithClassesToUse to filter a COCO dataset to only include annotations for a specified list of class names
register_sub_dataset_with_n_images: register a temporary sub-dataset with a limited number of images using the register_sub_dataset_with_n_images context manager
configure_dataset_creation: configure dataset creation settings including shared memory offload and disk cache using the configure_dataset_creation context manager
